title: SLUB LOD Entity
description: A Linked Open Data entity record returned by the SLUB Dresden LOD API. Entities are schema.org-typed authority/bibliographic resources across the entity-types organizations, persons, resources, works, events, topics and geo.

@context.description: JSON-LD context reference when format=json/jsonld is requested.

@type.description: schema.org type of the entity (e.g. Person, Organization, CreativeWork, Event, Place).

id.description: The identifier of the record (e.g. a GND/SWB/Wikidata id such as 118695940 or Q1585819).

preferredName.description: The preferred (authoritative) name of the entity.

alternateName.description: Alternate names / variant labels for the entity.

description.description: A short description of the entity.

additionalType.description: Further typing of the entity, each with a name/description.

sameAs.description: Authority-provider identifiers linking this entity to filmportal.de, swb, wd (Wikidata), isni, lc, orcid, gnd or viaf.
